name: KARANEKO Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Microsoft 64bit Windows 7
  • Processor: 64bit Intel compatible Dual Core CPU
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x960 display is recommended at x2 resolution but is not required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Microsoft 64bit Windows 10
  • Processor: 64bit Intel compatible Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated OpenGL 4-compliant onboard graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1280x960 display is recommended at x2 resolution but is not required

short_description: Karaneko is a bullet hell JRPG where players explore a pixel art fantasy world, examine objects, discover histories of three countries, and interact with NPCs. Choices impact the game, offering diverse genres like adventure, psychological, puzzle, visual novel, and horror.
